name: Hawaii
dueDateNotes: Hawaii estimated payments are due on the 20th — April 20, June 20, September 20, and January 20 — not the 15th like federal.
selfEmploymentNotes: Hawaii applies graduated 1.4%-11% rates to your federal AGI after the 2026 standard deduction ($8,000 single / $16,000 joint) plus a $1,144 personal exemption. It does NOT include Hawaii's General Excise Tax, which self-employed residents owe separately on gross receipts.
uniqueFacts: Hawaii has 12 income tax brackets — among the most of any state — topping out at 11%, one of the highest state rates in the country.
Hawaii self-employed people also owe the General Excise Tax (GET) of about 4%-4.5% on their gross business receipts, on top of income tax — a major cost this income-tax estimate does not include.
Hawaii's tax deadlines fall on the 20th (April 20, June 20, September 20, January 20), not the 15th.
